description: This file defines two Orleans grain interfaces with versioning attributes, including methods for retrieving version information and performing long-running tasks.

classes.name: IVersionUpgradeTestGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain interface with versioning, providing methods to get version info and perform tasks.

classes.description: An Orleans grain interface with versioning, providing method to get version info.
